text.body: śrīmānveṅkaṭanāthāryaḥ kavitārkikakesarī | vedāntācāryavaryo me sannidhattāṃ sadā hyṛdi || śrīśeṣaśailaśṛṅge tuṅge nigamottamāṅge ca | utsaṅge ca phaṇīndrasyojjvalamekaṃ bhaje tejaḥ || 1 || viracitakarmavicāraiḥ mumukṣubhiḥ tatphaleṣu vairāgyāt | yajjijñāsyaṃ puruṣaiḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 2 || utpattisthitivilayairbhuvanasyaitasya yatkāryaiḥ | yatprāptuṃ śakyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||3|| jagadekakāraṇaṃ yat sarvajñatvādiguṇagaṇābharaṇam | śāstraikasamadhigamyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje||4|| nikhilanigamāntavākyaiḥ puruṣārthatayā'bhidhīyamānatvāt | yadbhavati śāstravedyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 5 || īkṣādiśeṣavacanāt sacchabditakāraṇasya sadvidyā | yaditi vyanakti yat sat tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 6|| nirupadhikānandādyairānandamayaṃ vyanakti tadvidyā | itaravyāvṛttairyattadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 7 || ādityamaṇḍalāntarvartinamupadiśya puṇḍarīkākṣam | vidyā vyanakti taṃ yattadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 8 || ākāśasya vadanti yadekayogyān parāyaṇatvādīn | taṃ gamayati śrutiryattabrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||9|| prāṇasya kāraṇatvaṃ śrutibrrāuvāṇā prasiddhinirdeśāt | yaditi vyanakti tamimaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 10 || niratiśayadīptiyuktaṃ jyotiḥ pādo'sya bhūtāni | ityuktyā yadbhavati tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||11 || indraprāṇapadoktaṃ yaditi vyaktīkaroti yaddharmaiḥ | vidyā pratardanāṅkā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 12 || sarvaṃ brāhṛ yaduktaṃ tattajjatvādyanūktisāmathryāt | yaditi vyanakti vidyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 13 || attāramodanoktyā siddhaṃ mṛtyūpasecanatvoktyā | saṃhartṛ yaditi gamayati tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 14 || akṣipuruṣaṃ prasiddhaiścakṣuḥ sthityādibhirdharmaiḥ | yaditi vyanakti vidyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 15 || antaryāmitayoktaṃ yugapatsarvasya niyamanapramukhaiḥ | yaditi vyanakti vidyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 16 || yadbhūtayonirakṣaramuktaṃ yajjñāpakairdharmaiḥ | vidyā sphuṭayati tadyat tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||17 || vaiśvānarātmavidyā dyuprabhṛtīnāṃ tadaṅgatākathanāt | yaditi vyanakti tamimaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||18 || dyupṛthivyādyādhāraṃ kathayantyamṛtasya setumātmānam | yaditi vyanakti vidyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||19 || prāṇapadoktājjīvādarthāntaramavagamayya bhūmānam | yaditi vyanakti vidyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||20 || akṣaramasthūlamanaṇvityādyuktaṃ praśāsitṛtvādyaiḥ | yaditi vyanakti vidyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||21 || muktekṣyamāṇapuruṣaṃ ślokoktyā sūridṛśyamānatayā | yaditi vyanakti vidyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 22 || apahatapāpmatvādyairyaddharmairyaditi daharamākāśam | vivṛṇoti daharavidyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||23 || aṅguṣṭhamātrapuruṣaṃ manuṣyahmadayasthamīśitṛtvādyaiḥ | yaditi vyanakti vidyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||24 || duḥkhatrayābhibhūtairātyantikatannivṛttikāmanayā | devairapi yadupāsyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 25 || vasurudrādipadasthairbhūyastatprāptikāmanāvadbhiḥ | svāvasthaṃ yadupāsyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 26 || śuśrūṣuṃ prati guruṇā śūdretyāmantraṇasya dṛṣṭasya | śocananimittakatayā śūdreṣvadhikāragamakatāvirahāt || 27 || |śūdrasyāpi mumukṣorvedādhyayanādirahitatayā | nādhikṛtiryadupāstau tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 28 || ākāśasya vadantī śrutiranyā nāmarūpakartṛtvam | yaditi vyanakti tamimaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 29 || yogivaśīkaraṇīyeṣvindriyapūrveṣu yasya mukhyatvam | abhidhatte kaṭhavallī tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 30 || yatkāryatvaṃ prakṛteḥ prajāḥ sṛjantyā ajāśrutibrrāūte | śakhāntaraikakaṇṭhāt tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 31 || pañcajanaśabditānāmākāśasyendriyāṇāṃ ca | yadadhīnā sthitiruktā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 32 || sarvajñatvādipuruṣaṃ yadeva viyadādikāraṇatvena | śrutayo vadanti sarvāḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 33 || yasyaitatkarmeti śrutirakṣādipramāṇasiddhasya | brāūte yatkāryatvaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 34 || draṣṭavya iti ya uktastasyāmṛtahetutādyuktyā | sa yaditi gamayati vidyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 35 || yasyaikasya jñānāt jñātamidaṃ bhavati sarvamityuktyā | gamayati yadupādānaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 36 || taistaiḥ śivādiśabdairabhihitamapi vastu yaddharmaiḥ | gamayanti yaditi vidyāḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 37 || manvādyāptabahusmṛtyupabṛṃhitavedamaulisiddhatayā | yaddhetutvamacālyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 38 || |dravyaikyameva niyataṃ prakṛtivikṛtyorna sājātyam | cidaciccharīrakasya brāhṛṇa evātra hetukāryatvāt || 39 || antaryāmibrāāhṛṇasiddhatvāddehadehibhāvasya | apṛthaksiddhe jagati brāhṛ prati dehalakṣmasatvācca || 40 || dehagatāvasthānāṃ dehinyātmanyananvayāccāpi | yaddhetutvamacālyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 41 || kaṇabhakṣādimatānāmanyonyaṃ vyāhatatvena | yaddhetutvamacālyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 42 || karmakṛtabhoktṛtayā akarmavaśye prasaktyabhāvena | yaddhetutvamacālyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 43 || śrutibhirupapāditatvāt prakṛtivikṛtyorabhedasya | yaddhetutvamacālyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||44|| tatvamasītyādīnāmanyaparatvājjagatruāṣṭuḥ | sṛjyasya ca jīvasya svarūpabhedasya duṣprakampatayā || 45 || jīvāhitakaraṇe'pi svāhitakaraṇasaṅgaviraheṇa | yaddhetutvamacālyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 46|| asahakṛtakṣīrāderdadhyādyāraṃbhadarśanālloke | sahakāriniyamavirahāt śaktimatāṃ teṣu teṣu kāryeṣu ||47|| sahakāramantaraivaṃ jagadāraṃbhasya saṃbhavāt prakṛte | yaddhetutvamacālyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 48 || dharmigrāhakamānāt yadvastu yathaiva siddhyati tathaiva | tatsvīkāryaṃ sarvaiḥ brāhṛaikaṃ niṣkalaṃ ca bahu bhavati || 49 || |ityāgamasiddhe'rthe laukikacodyasya niravakāśatvāt | yaddhetutvamacālyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||50 || līlāpravṛttasṛṣṭāvasaṃbhavānniṣprayojanatvasya | yaddhetutvamacālyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 51 || prājñānadhiṣṭhitānāṃ dārvādīnāṃ acetanānāṃ na | dṛṣṭaḥ kāryāraṃbhaḥ tasmādacitaḥ pradhānasya || 52 || |kāryāraṃbhakatāyāḥ sāṅkhyoktāyā asaṃbhavāchrautam | yaddhetutvaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 53 || paramāṇavo niraṃśā yadi yogāsaṃbhavāt teṣām | dvyaṇukāraṃbho na syāt yadi sāṃśāste'pi tadvat syuḥ || 54 || ityanavasthetyādyaiḥ vaiśeṣikadarśanasya duṣṭatvāt | yaddhetutvaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||55 || kṣaṇikaparamāṇuvāde paramāṇūnāṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ dhvaṃsāt | taiḥ samudāyāsiddheḥ tadasiddhau dehasiddhivirahācca || 56 || |jagadāraṃbhāsiddhyā duḥsthatvāt bauddhadarśanasyāpi | yaddhetutvaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 57 || jñānaviṣayāśrayāṇāṃ upalaṃbhe sadṛśi bādhavirahe ca | viṣayāśrayau nirasya jñānasyaikasya pāramārthoktyā || 58 || yogācāramatasyāpyatidauḥsthyenāpramāṇatvāt | yaddhetutvaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||59|| svasmin pramāṇasatve'satve vā śūnyavādasya | unmajjanaviraheṇa svāsiddhyāpādakatvena || 60 || |atyantaṃ duḥsthatayā mādhyamikasya pakṣasya | yaddhetutvaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 61 || tejo'ndhakārayoriva parasparaviruddhayorubhayoḥ | sarvasminnapi vastuni satvāsatvādidharmayoḥ kathanāt || 62 || atyantaṃ duḥsthatayā jainābhimatasya pakṣasya | yaddhetutvaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 63 || paśupatiraśeṣajagataḥ kartopādānakāraṇaṃ triguṇam | anumānagamya īśvara iti vedaviruddhakalpanāt bahudhā ||64 || karaṇaṃ yathā'dhitiṣṭhati jīvaḥ prakṛtiṃ tathaiveśaḥ | adhitiṣṭhatītyupagame sukhaduḥkhādeḥ prasaṅgācca || 65 || pāśupatasya matasyāpyatiduḥsthatvāt śrutipramitam | yaddhetutvaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 66 || vyūhaviśeṣaparatvāt jīvotpattyādivādivacanasya | vedavirodhābhāvāt kutrāpi ca pāñcarātratantrasya || 67 || aprāmāṇyābhāvāt pramāṇamūrdhanyatantrasiddhatayā | yaddhetutvaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 68 || jñāte brāhṛṇi sarvaṃ jñātaṃ bhavatīti yā pratijñoktā | utpattyanabhyupagame tadanirvāhānniṣedhavirahācca || 69 || svīkartavyotpattiḥ brāhṛta eveti niścayāt viyataḥ | yatkāryatvamabhagnaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 70 || svasya bahutvotpattī saṃkalpya samastamasṛjaditi siddhyā | brāhṛaiva vāyurūpāttasmādajaniṣṭa vahnirūpamiti || 71 || arthāvagateḥ siddhā śrutyantarataśca sarvasya | yata utpattiḥ sākṣāt tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 72 || utpattipratiṣedhāt nityatvokteśca jīvasya | nāstyutpattirathāpi pratijñayā prāgudāhmatayā || 73 || saṃkocādivikārijñānākhyaguṇapraṇāḍikayā | yatkāryatvamabhagnaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||74 || na jñānamātramātmā nāpi ca vijñātṛtaikarūpo vā | jñānasvarūpatāyāḥ śrutibhirvijñātṛtāyāśca || 75 || tasya bahuśo'bhidhānāduktajñānapraṇāḍikayā | yatkāryatvamabhagnaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 76|| yaccoditeṣu karmasvātmā kartā tadā'sya ca vidheśca | phalavattāyāḥ siddheḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 77 || laukikavaidikakarmasu kartṛtvaṃ pratyagātmano yattat | yadadhīnamāha nigamaḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 78 || gotvādiriva gavāderādityādeḥ prabhādiriva | yasyāṃśo'sau jīvaḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje|| 79 || jīvopakārakatayā tatkaraṇānāmaṇūnāṃ ca | ekādaśendriyāṇāṃ prāṇasya ca vāyuto'nyasya || 80 || karaṇasyāṇoryasmādutpatteḥ śrūyamāṇatayā | yatkāryatvamabhagnaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||81 || agnyādidevatānāṃ jīvānāṃ cendriyādyadhiṣṭhānam | yatsaṅkalpāyattaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 82 || manasā sahendriyatvaṃ vāgādīnāṃ ca cakṣurādīnām | gītāsu yena gītaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 83 || tejojalapṛthivīnāmaṇḍādivyaṣṭisṛṣṭartham | anyonyaṃ yanmiśrīkaraṇaṃ tatkartṛkartṛkatvena || 84 || devādināmarūpavyākaraṇaṃ vyāharannigamaḥ | yatkāryaṃ tat kathayati tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 85 || pañcāgniviṣayavidyā saṃsṛtibandhotthakhedavivṛtiparā | iṣṭāpūrtādikṛto dehāddehāntaraprāptau || 86 || gatimāha bhūtasūkṣmaissaṃparirabdhasya sendriyaprāṇaiḥ | yatsaṅkalpāyattāṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||87|| sukṛtaphale bhukte satyabhuktaphalakarmabhissahitaḥ | yasyecchayā'varohati tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 88 || vidyākarmavihīnāḥ pāpakṛto yasya saṃkalpāt | narakāneva bhajante tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje ||89 || avarohangaganādyaissaṃśleṣaṃ kamapi yatkṛtaṃ prāpya | niṣkrāmatyanaticirāt tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 90 || meghānniṣkrāntassan, vrīhibhiranyasya dehatāṃ prāptaiḥ| śliṣyati yatsaṃkalpāt tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 91 || rathaveśantaprabhṛtīnyatyāścaryāṇi dehināṃ svapne | sṛjati yadacintyaśaktyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 92 || āyasto'yaṃ jīvaḥ karaṇaissaha tūlatalpa iva | śete yatra suṣuptau tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 93 || yatra śayanena jīvassvāsthyaṃ samavāpya bhūyo'pi | uttiṣṭhati talpādiva tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 94 || yatkāritāsu jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyādyavasthāsu | mūrchānyābhyo bhinnā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 95 || yatsaṃbandhājjīve jāyante jāgradādayo doṣāḥ | tena śarīreṇa samaṃ satyapi yoge na te doṣāḥ || 96 || yasminsaṃbadhyante heyānāṃ pratibhaṭasvabhāvatayā | kalyāṇaguṇatayāpi ca tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 97 || yasyāṃśabhūtametanmūrtāmūrtātmakaṃ viśvam | bhāsvata iva prakāśastadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 98 || sarvasmātparamaṃ yat yasmātparamaṃ na kiñcidapyasti | guṇataḥ svarūpato vā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 99 || karmabhirupāsanaiścāśeṣairārādhitaṃ prasannaṃ yat | sakalaphalapradamekaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 100 || vaiśvānaradaharādyā yadvidyāścodanādyabhedena | śākhādvaye'pyabhinnāḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 101 || yadupāsanopakṛtaye tvāmnāte prāṇadṛṣṭirūpe ye | udgīthopāstī dve udgātari prāṇadṛṣṭirekasyām || 102 || udgīthāṅge praṇave tvitarasyāmiti ca rūpabhedena | vidye te bhidyete tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 103 || kauṣītakyuktāyāṃ yadadhīnaprāṇaviṣayavidyāyām | chāndogyoktāyāṃ ca śraiṣṭhavataḥ prāṇarūpavedyasya || 104 || śraiṣṭhopapādanasya ca sarvasyāpyekarūpatayā | vidye ubhe abhinne tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 105 || paravidyāsvakhilāsvapi cidacidvyāvartakairviśiṣṭaṃ yat | satyatvādyaidhryeyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 106 || vājasaneye sāmni ca yadadhīnaprāṇaviṣayavidyāyām | prāṇopāsananiṣṭhaiḥ pūrvaṃ parataśca bhuktīnām ||107 || ācamane viniyuktāsvapsveva prāṇavāsastvam | anusandheyaṃ vihitaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 108 || upaniṣadi vājināṃ dviḥ śrutā'pi śāṇḍilyavidyaikā | ekatra yasya kathayantyamoghasaṅkalpatākhyaguṇam || 109 || tasyaiva vitatibhedān sarvavaśitvapraśāsitṛtvādyān | anyatra prāha guṇāṃstadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 110 || ādityamaṇḍalasthaṃ tvahariti nāmnā yadakṣiniṣṭhaṃ tu | ahamiti nāmnopāsyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 111 || yaddyuvyāptyādiguṇā alpāyatanānyaviṣayavidyāsu | vyavatiṣṭhante dhyeyāstadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 112 || brāhṛprāptiphalaikā nānyā'taḥ puruṣavidyayorbhedaḥ | yatprāptyaprāptibhyāṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 113 || yadupāsanāvidhāyakavedādhyayane bhavanti viniyuktāḥ | mantrāśśaṃ no mukhyāstadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 114 || yadvidyāphalabhūtau yau yanniṣṭhasya sukṛtaduṣkṛtayoḥ | niśśeṣatayā hānistanmitrāmitrayoḥ praveśaśca ||115 || dvāvetayodrvayorapi cintanamakhilāsu vidyāsu | yaccintanavatkāryaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 116 || yadvidyāphalabhūto viduṣo'khilapuṇyapāpaviśleṣaḥ | dehānnirgamakāle tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 117 || ye ceme'raṇya iti śrutiriyamāhārcirādigatim | akhilayadupāsakānāṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 118 || heyapratibhaṭatātmakamamalatvaṃ yasya sarvavidyāsu | upasaṃhāryaṃ rūpaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 119 || uṣastikaholapraśnapratyuktyorbhedadarśane'pi tayoḥ | sarvāntaratvamekaṃ praṣṭṛprativaktrabhipretam || 120 || itaradvyāvṛttyarthamiti pratītervivakṣitā tatra | yadviṣayā vidyaikā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 121 || vājasaneye sāmni ca yadviṣaye daharavidye ye | setutvavidhāraṇādyaiḥ saiveyamiti pratīyamānatayā || 122 || "sarvaśya vaśī " tyādyairguṇāṣṭakasyātra vedyatāvagatam | bhidyete na mithaste tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 123 || udgīthavedanasyābhāvepi kratvanuṣṭhitaiḥ śravaṇāt | tadvedanasya niyamābhāvasya kratuṣu lābhena || 124 || tadvedanasahitā vā rahitā vā te'khilāḥ kratavaḥ | yadupāsanāṅgabhūtāstadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 125 || daharopāsananiṣṭhairguṇavaiśiṣṭasvarūpābhyām | yatpṛthaganusandheyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 126 || nārāyaṇānuvāke tattadvidyāsu śivapadādyuktam | yaditi niraṇāyi vākyaistadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 127 || vākcinmanaścidādyāścīyante yatkṛte kratostasya | bhavati hi yadeva phaladaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 128 || paravidyāsūpāsyo jīvātmā yadviśeṣaṇatvena | śuddhākāra upāsyaḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 129 || sarvāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ udgīthapadena dhīsthatvāt | tattadvyaktiviśeṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ saṃbaddhyamānāni || 130 || tadupāsanāni tadvat saṃbaddhyante'khilāsu śākhāsu | yadyajanarūpakarmasu tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 131 || vaiśvānaravidyāyāṃ trailokyaśarīrameva yadupāsyam | na tvekaikāvayavaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 132 || guṇacodanādibhedādānandamayādayo vidyāḥ | yadviṣayā bhidyante tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 133 || ekaphalasādhanatvāt yadvidyānāṃ samastānām | nirṇīyate vikalpastadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 134 || purūṣārthatvāvagaternodgīthopāsanasya niyamo'sti | yadyajanarūpakarmasu tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 135 || tattatkarmopakṛtāt yadupāsanataḥ phalāvāptiḥ | śrutivākyebhyassiddhaḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 136|| yadyajanarūpakarmaṇyudgītho rasatamatvena | śrutyopāsyo vihitastadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 137 || sadvidyādyāraṃbheṣvākhyānaiḥ śvetaketumukhyānām | yadvidyāḥ stūyante tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 138 || yajñādyanadhikṛtā ye tvāśramiṇasteṣu yadvidyā | nākāṅkṣati yajñādīṃstadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 139 || yajñādhikāravatsu tvagnyādhānādikān sarvān | ākāṅkṣati yadvidyā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 140 || yajñādhikāravatsvapi yadvidyā śamadamādisāpekṣā | aṅgatayā vihitatvāt tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 141 || prāṇavido'pyatiśakteryanniṣṭhasyā'pi bhojanāniyamaḥ | atyantāpadviṣayastadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 142 || yadupāsanāṅgabhūtaṃ yajñādikamaṅgamāśramasyāpi | bhavati viniyogabhedāt tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 143 || svārhairdānajapādyairapi siddhessaṃbhavādvidhuraḥ | yadupāstāvadhikurute tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 144 || ārūḍhāḥ patitā ye saṃnyāsādyāśramāt teṣām | nādhikṛtiryadupāstau tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 145 || yadvidyāsahakārikratvaṅgodgīthavedanāḥ sarvāḥ | ṛtvigbhiḥ kartavyāstadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 146 || yasya śubhāśrayamananaṃ śamādivat yasya cintāyāḥ | sahakāritayā vihitaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 147 || yadvidyāniṣṭhasya prakṛṣṭamāhātmyaśālino vihitam | mahimānāviṣkaraṇaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 148 || na niyatiraiśvaryaphalā yadvidyotpadyate tadaiveti | dharmeṣvanuṣṭhiteṣvapi tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 149 || yadvidyā prabalatamāpyasati pratibandhake prabale | utpadyate tadānīṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 150 || apavargasādhanaṃ yadvedanamāvartanīyamasakṛditi | śrutyaikakaṇṭhasiddhaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 151 || parajīvayorupāsyopāsakayossvarūpabhede'pi | tādātmyasya vidhānācchatibhirdehātmabhāvasya || 152 || ātmetyupāsyatāyā vihitatvādapyupāsitrā | ātmeti tu yadupāsyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 153 || yaddṛṣṭopāsyānāṃ nāmādīnāmanātmatvāt | ātmatvaṃ nopāsyaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 154 || yadupāsanasahakārikratvaṅgodgītha eva tu nikṛṣṭe | ādityadṛṣṭirucitā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 155 || yadupāsanamapi niyamādāsīnenaiva kartavyam | aikāgryasiddhihetoḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 156 || yāvajjīvaṃ kāryaṃ yadupāsanamanvahaṃ dhyātrā | śrutiṣu tathaiva vidhānāt tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 157 || abhyāsādyadupāsterdarśanasamarūpatāsiddhau | tatpūrvaviracitānāṃ niśśeṣaṃ bhavati pāpmanāṃ nāśaḥ || 158 || uttarakālakṛtānāṃ prāmādikapāpmanāmasaṃśleṣaḥ | yadvidyāmāhātmyāt tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 159 || yadvidyayaiva bhavataḥ pūrvottarasukṛtasaṃkṣayāśleṣau | aśleṣo dehānte tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 160 || pūrvakṛtayodrvayorapi phaladānāyāpravṛttayoreva | yadvidyayā vināśastadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 161 || sarve'pyāśramadharmā anicchatā cāpi tatphalaṃ viduṣā | yadvidyārthaṃ kāryāstadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 162 || yadupāsakasya puṃsaḥ phaladānāya pravṛttakarmāṇi | nāśyāni tadupabhogāt tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 163 || sarvendriyāṇi jantormaraṇadaśāyāṃ yadīyasaṅkalpāt | saṃyujyante manasā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 164 || sarvendriyasaṃyuktaṃ manastu saṅkalpato yasya | prāṇena bhavati yuktaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 165 || karaṇasahitena manasā yuktaḥ prāṇastu puruṣeṇa | yatsaṅkalpāt śliṣyati tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 166 || prāṇaḥ puruṣeṇa yuto bhūtaissaha yasya saṅkalpāt | saṃsṛṣṭo bhavati tadā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 167 || yadupāsananiṣṭhānāmitareṣāṃ ceyamutkrāntiḥ | yasyecchayā samānā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 168 || karaṇamanaḥprāṇaissaha jīvena ca bhūtasūkṣmāṇi | saṃpadyante yasmin tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 169 || yasmin maraṇadaśāyāṃ saṃpattirbhūmasūkṣmajīvānām | saṅgativiśeṣarūpā tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 170 || yadanugrahato vidvān nāḍā mūrdhanyayā śatādhikayā | nirgacchati svadehāt tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 171 || ādityasya sa raśmīn anusṛtyaiva pratiṣṭhate dehāt | yadunugraheṇa vidvān tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 172 || yadupāsako niśāyāṃ mriyamāṇo'pyakhilakarmaṇāṃ nāśāt | yatprāpnotyavilaṃbāt tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 173 || yadvidyāmanutiṣṭhan mriyamāṇo dakṣiṇe'pyayane | brāhṛ prāpnoti paraṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 174 || tadupāsīnassarvo'pyekenaivārcirādimārgeṇa | prāpnoti yasya lokān tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 175 || yadupāsako'rcirādau mārge saṃvatsaraṃ prāpya | paścādgacchati vāyuṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 176 || yadupāsako'rcirādau taṭitaṃ prāpyātha varuṇamāpnoti | indramatha brāhṛāṇaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 177 || yadupāsananiṣṭhānāṃ ativahaneṣvarcirādayaḥ puruṣāḥ | yena niyuktā mārge tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 178 || pañcāgnividaḥ puruṣāt brāhṛvidaścātivāhikagaṇaḥ saḥ | ativahati yanniyuktaḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 179 || karmatirohitarūpo bhavatyayaṃ yadupasaṃpattyā | āvirbhavatsvarūpaḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 180 || bandhakakarmavimuktaḥ puruṣo'yaṃ yadviśeṣaṇatvena | anubhavati svātmānaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 181 || apahatapāpmatvādyaiḥ āvirbhavati svayaṃprakāśo'yam | yatsaṃpattyā jīvaḥ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 182 || yatparicaraṇāsakto muktaḥ saṅkalpamātreṇa | prāpnoti kāmitārthān tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 183 || satanuḥ kadācidatanuḥ bhūtvā mukto yathākāmam | anubhavati yasya līlāṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 184 || muktaḥ sa bhogamātre paramaṃ sāmyaṃ prayāti yena samam | vicchedakathārahitaṃ tadbrāhṛ śrīnivāsanāma bhaje || 185 || adhikaraṇaratnamālā grathitā śrīdeśikāryeṇa | ullāsamāvahantī jayatu śrīśrīnivāsahmadaye'sau ||
